= King Speddie =
Edward "Eddie" Canmann (born August 30, 2010), commonly known as King Speddie, is an American rapper known for his album Twenty Forty-Eight, released in late 2025.
Early life
Edward Canmann was born to parents in Winnetka, Illinois, a suburb of Chicago. Growing up, he aspired to be the President of the United States in the 2048 election, connecting to his album, Twenty Forty-Eight. Eddie worked as an employee at McDonald's over the summer of ninth grade, before releasing his first song, ''Life's a Blessing (Version 1).
Career
Eddie first publicly released his songs to his YouTube account, [https://www.youtube.com/@kingspeddie] before officially releasing his song OOIF'' to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, and Amazon Music in early 2026.
